sections.怎么用这页:
Use these four blocks for pre-release review and incident analysis. Replace project fields. The weights, sample counts and thresholds are illustrative; define actual criteria before evaluation. Authorization or safety failures should not be offset by a weighted average.

### 1. Evaluation rubric
```text
Dimension | Example weight | Threshold | Evidence
Task completion | 30% | [X]% | Fixed task set (example: 100)
Citation accuracy | 20% | [X]% | Source checks (example: 20)
Required refusals | 20% | [X]% | Out-of-scope questions
Tool correctness | 15% | [X]% | Invocation logs
Average turns | 10% | [N] | Session logs
Latency | 5% | [N] seconds | Monitoring

Example scoring: 1–5 per dimension, with an agreed minimum.
Specify non-negotiable permission/safety conditions separately.
```

### 2. Four layers of controls
```text
Input: identify/redact personal data; check injection; handle long inputs;
restrict file types.
Knowledge: answer within the permitted corpus; cite supporting passages;
retire outdated records; preserve conflicts.
Tools: restrict names; validate schemas; require appropriate approval for writes;
limit call frequency.
Output: check sensitive commitments; define escalation; retain suitable traces;
provide rollback.
```

### 3. Service-agent acceptance
```text
- [ ] Intents and excluded requests reviewed
- [ ] Approved knowledge has effective dates
- [ ] Write authorization is enforced
- [ ] Task set covers frequent and prohibited requests (100 is illustrative)
- [ ] Incorrect commitments monitored with defined stop conditions
- [ ] Escalation conditions and owners recorded
- [ ] Log retention checked against applicable requirements
- [ ] Rollback exercised
```

### 4. Incident record
```text
Record | Evidence
Occurrence/discovery time |
Affected users/orders/data |
Input/knowledge/tool/output path |
Model/version |
Controls that fired |
Rollback time/method |
Reproducible cause |
Fix/regression checks |
Related risk review |

Separate evidence, hypotheses and confirmed causes.
```
sections.常见误用:
- Test appropriate refusals as well as answerability.
- Controls need observable behavior and records, not documentation alone.
- Repeat relevant checks after knowledge or configuration changes.
- Incident explanations need reproducible evidence; keep unconfirmed hypotheses labeled.
